paras: Optimise the front-end geometry of your BMW 3 Series (G20/G21) or G8X M-series (M2 G87, M3 G80/G81, M4 G82/G83) with AST Adjustable Camber Top Mounts. These mounts are a critical upgrade for drivers seeking to eliminate understeer and maximise cornering grip by allowing for precise camber adjustment.

Constructed from high-grade aluminium, these plates replace the soft factory rubber mounts to provide a rigid connection to the chassis. This design eliminates deflection under heavy cornering loads, resulting in significantly sharper steering response and improved feedback. Featuring eccentric movement for accurate camber adjustment, these mounts allow you to dial in the perfect alignment for both spirited road use and competitive track days. They are designed to integrate seamlessly with the original suspension mounting points.
hl: Precision Adjustment: Camber adjustable with eccentric movement for fine-tuned alignment control.
Rigid Construction: Manufactured from high-grade aluminium for maximum strength and weight reduction.
Enhanced Steering: Removes the flex of factory rubber mounts for a more direct and communicative steering feel.
Pillowball Bearings: Equipped with high-quality, maintenance-free bearings for smooth and reliable operation.
OEM Integration: Designed to work with the original suspension mounting points.
Quality Assurance: 100% Made in The Netherlands to professional motorsport standards.
